metadata.title: The Milky Way bar potential constrained by the kinematics of SiO maser stars in BAaDE Survey

notes: No eligible stars. The paper analyzes the BAaDE SiO maser sample in aggregate to constrain the Milky Way bar potential; it does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate, nor does it follow up an individual star previously identified as such. The reported high line-of-sight velocities are used to define an ensemble l-v envelope and do not constitute an explicit claim that any star is unbound from the Milky Way.
